svg.title: Head and neck: anatomically informed sagittal, lateral and posterior teaching views
svg.desc: Original anatomical illustration. Adult head near-midline section facing right with the nasal septum removed to reveal the lateral nasal wall; separate lateral head and posterior thyroid views. Off-midline structures are not placed in the midline section. Different scales; small glands enlarged. Anatomical variation is simplified. Not for diagnosis or procedures.

text.data-zh: 近正中切面 · 已移去鼻中隔

text.data-en: Eye, ear and glands lie off the midline
text.data-zh: 眼、耳与腺体位于正中面外

g.text: Eye, ear and glands lie off the midline

text.data-en: Nasal septum removed to reveal the conchae.
text.data-zh: 移去鼻中隔，以显示鼻甲。

g.text: Nasal septum removed to reveal the conchae.

text.data-en: Separate views; different scales. Small glands enlarged.
text.data-zh: 各视图比例不同；小腺体经放大。

g.text: Separate views; different scales. Small glands enlarged.
